confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge, not checked against live menus, listings or booking pages. Restaurant and cafe anchors are more reliable; July hostel and hotel rates vary widely by date and room type, so they are least certain. Euro prices assume about 1.16 USD per EUR, not a live rate. Beer assumes a 0.33 L draft and meal anchors exclude drinks. Cocktail and wine were partly set from the beer relationship (cocktail about 2.9x beer, house wine about 1.4x). The FX figure comes from search summaries of RBA data, not a direct page read.
comparable_city_reasoning: General-knowledge basis: Albufeira as a mid-sized Algarve beach resort, using nearby resort towns such as Lagos and Portimão as the regional reference point. Peak-season (July) pricing applied to accommodation. Not checked against live data.
